values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. Choose a smooth unit normal field $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ on $\Omega$ as in the normal context. For $w=aX_u(q)+bX_v(q)$ and $z=cX_u(q)+dX_v(q)$, put $\xi=(a,b)$. Then $\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)=-\langle d\boldsymbol N_q(\xi),z\rangle$, where $d\boldsymbol N_q:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ differentiates the parameter-domain map on $\Omega$ and $dX_q(\xi)=w$. Equivalently, on the local sheet this is $-\langle d\boldsymbol N(w),z\rangle$.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。选定法向语境中的光滑单位法向场 $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$（条件只在 $\Omega$ 上要求）。设 $w=aX_u(q)+bX_v(q)$、$z=cX_u(q)+dX_v(q)$，令 $\xi=(a,b)$。则 $\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)=-\langle d\boldsymbol N_q(\xi),z\rangle$，其中 $d\boldsymbol N_q:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 是在 $\Omega$ 上对参数域映射求微分，且 $dX_q(\xi)=w$。在局部曲面片上，这正是 $-\langle d\boldsymbol N(w),z\rangle$。
